2014_spells.spirit-shroud-2.description: You call spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the duration. The spells has no effect on Undead. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. This extra damage is of a type determined by the type of spirit you call: radiant, necrotic, or cold (your choice). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, it must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. As a bonus action on your turn, you can increase the radius of the spirit shroud's area by 10 feet. The maximum radius is 30 feet.
2014_spells.spirit-shroud-2.effectSummar: Make a target frightened until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.spirit-shroud-2.fullDescript: Using 1 bonus action, if the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, it must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you; As a bonus action on your turn, you can increase the radius of the spirit shroud's area by 10 feet; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 3rd. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
